description.value: Stillfood Bistro is a café and bistro offering artisan coffee and fresh fare, with an OSM record noting vegan dietary options that may appeal to plant-based touring cyclists. The business has an active website and a presence in the Okanagan–Thompson region. Its exact location is uncertain due to a discrepancy between its website branding (Penticton) and its mapped OSM coordinates (Salmon Arm).

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is almost entirely cookie consent banners, yielding only the page title 'StillFood Bistro | Artisan Coffee & Fresh Fare in Penticton' as usable business information — no address, phone, menu details, or amenity confirmation could be extracted. OSM tags note diet:vegan=yes and internet_access=wlan, but per schema rules these cannot be treated as authoritative for amenity claims without website corroboration, so all amenity fields default to null. Critically, the OSM coordinates (50.70°N, 119.28°W) and postal code V1E 4H7 both correspond to Salmon Arm, BC, while the website branding says 'in Penticton' — a geographic discrepancy of approximately 130 km that is flagged in concerns.
concerns: Geographic discrepancy: website title reads 'Artisan Coffee & Fresh Fare in Penticton' but OSM coordinates (50.70°N, 119.28°W) and postal code V1E 4H7 both place the record in Salmon Arm, BC — approximately 130 km from Penticton. The OSM record may have incorrect coordinates, or the business may have relocated without updating its website branding.
Website content was almost entirely cookie consent banners; no street address, phone number, menu items, or amenity details could be extracted to cross-check OSM data.
OSM name is 'Stillfood Bistro' but the website renders it as 'StillFood Bistro' (capital F) — minor name inconsistency.
OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and internet_access=wlan could not be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is real and active with a functioning website and OSM record; the geographic discrepancy is a data-quality concern but not grounds for exclusion.
